description: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn over a Polish city for the next seven nights: when each is at least 10° up in the dark, its highest point, brightness and the cloud cover then. Warsaw when no place is given.

city.description: One of the 18 Polish voivodeship seats, e.g. "Kraków", "Gdańsk", "Warsaw" (Białystok, Bydgoszcz, Gdańsk, Gorzów Wielkopolski, Katowice, Kielce, Kraków, Lublin, Łódź, Olsztyn, Opole, Poznań, Rzeszów, Szczecin, Toruń, Warszawa, Wrocław, Zielona Góra)

lang.description: Language of the answer: pl (default) or en

lat.description: Latitude of another place: the nearest seat is used
